research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Vivun is researching natural language text processing for automated product gap clustering and prioritization, focusing on digitally storing and analyzing various digital objects representing natural language text. Additionally, they are developing machine mediated requirement management in a software trial management system, which involves generating unique identifiers for digital workspaces and managing permissions between accounts. These areas reflect Vivun’s focus on AI-driven sales agent solutions and digital workflow management.
